_comment: A Schedule's only input is a plain object holding a string, and its callback calls the method of a captured service that the string names. The object holds no service, so assumption 4 allows it as a Schedule input: the named method stays and the bundle runs. Guards that untracked Schedule values keep the keys of service-free object inputs. The unread one is not checked: Schedule.fromStep's step is a callback handed to type-modelled code and runs with unknown arguments, so the computed read through its input is an unknown key and keeps every method (accepted imprecision; the pass no longer steps a Schedule).
